title: refactor(objectql): move the ObjectQL constructor body into the hooks-and-functions facet (E3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiP9RS1KjicEPyef7VNhFzFa)_

domain:server#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fL8RrJDkowuFhXUPG

Refs #30020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — an internal move inside `@objectstack/objectql` plus a build script; nothing a metadata author writes changes

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:给 `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 加了构造函数能力和新规则 R8(确定赋值 wiring),再用它把 `ObjectQL` 构造函数体搬进 `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts` 的 `construct`;构造函数只留签名、一行 `this.logger = …constructLogger(hostContext)` 和一次 `construct.call(…)`。登记表删掉构造函数这一行例外(17 → 16)。这是 #30020 §5 系列的 E3。
- 为什么改:构造函数是登记表里一条 "state-owning" 例外。`logger` 是严格模式下只能在构造函数里赋值的字段,整句挪出就是 TS2564,所以席位裁定走方案 A:R8 只把这一句的赋值留在类上、右值挪进 facet,其余语句按 R1 照搬。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,同样的语句、同样的顺序执行。撤销证明逐字节通过;三个公开 `.d.ts` 与 main 构建结果逐字节相同;objectql 全量测试通过。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的构造函数(3 行);`engine-hooks-and-functions.ts` 的 `constructLogger` / `construct`;codemod 里 `definiteAssignmentsOf`、`ctorStubBody`、`verifyCtorMove`、`ctorUndoText`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base origin/main` 预期 exit 0,输出 “1 moved method(s) (constructor); engine.ts 10739 -> 10712 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base … byte-for-byte”。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。codemod 新增了一条规则,是否要契约复审由席位决定。

## What changes

- **Codemod capability: the constructor (`--members constructor`).** The members pass now plans, writes and proves a move of `ObjectQL`'s constructor. The body becomes `static construct(this: Pick<Host, …>, …): void` in its section's facet. It takes only the parameters it reads, because the package builds with `noUnusedParameters`. The constructor keeps its signature and becomes the marker line, the R8 assignments, and one `Facet.construct.call(host.of(this), …)`.
- **New rule R8, definite-assignment wiring (seat ruling: option A).** A field a strict compiler requires the constructor to assign is one with a declared type, no initializer, no `?`/`!`, and a type that does not admit `undefined`. That assignment stays on the class. Each **leading** `this.F = EXPR;` whose EXPR reads no `this`, `super` or `arguments` and no top-level name of `engine.ts` becomes `this.F = Facet.constructF(<params EXPR reads>)`. `constructF` returns EXPR, typed as `ObjectQL['F']`. The facet body keeps a marker line where the statement stood, and the undo turns the marker back into the statement. Any other write to such a field keeps the constructor whole (stay reason `definite-assignment`). A class that already declares `construct` refuses (`ctor-facet-name`).
- **The move (E3).** `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members constructor --write` on `main` `af3451b08b`. Output tree sha256 `f0552217…`, the same on a second run from the base. It writes:
  - in `engine.ts`, the 3-line constructor and three new host-factory entries (`_registry`, `manifests`, `registerMiddleware`);
  - in `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`, the two facet members, three `HooksAndFunctionsHost` members and four imports;
  - four import bindings pruned from `engine.ts` (`STORED_METADATA_TYPE_READ_GATE_OBJECTS`, `createLogger`, `startSummaryRefreshOnEnable`, `storedMetadataTypeReadGate`).

  Nothing was hand-edited. `engine.ts` goes from 10,739 to 10,712 lines.
- **`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`**: the `ObjectQL` · `constructor` row (`#30020`) is removed. Exceptions 17 → 16. The `#30020` rows left in `engine.ts` are `update`, `insert`, `delete`, `[SEED_USER_GRANTS]` and `transaction`. The gate accepts the new constructor as wiring: `this.x = <forwarding call>` plus a forwarding call.
- **`.changeset/30020-objectql-constructor-facet.md`**: `@objectstack/objectql` patch (the source maps ship).
- **Anchors:** none to repoint. No `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` or `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` anchor cites any of the four pruned names as `engine.ts#…`, or the constructor. `packages/spec/**` is untouched.

### Constructor statements and how each moved

| # | Statement | Rule | Where it is now |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `this.logger = hostContext.logger \|\| createLogger({…});` | **R8** (`logger` is `private logger: Logger;`, a required field) | The assignment stays on the class: `this.logger = HooksAndFunctionsFacet.constructLogger(hostContext);`. The right side is in `constructLogger`. |
| 2 | `this._registry.onPackageUninstalled((id) => { this.manifests.delete(id); });` | host read (`_registry`, `manifests` getters) | `construct`, byte for byte |
| 3 | `this._registry.onPackageEnabled((id) => startSummaryRefreshOnEnable(this, this.logger, id));` | **R1** (`this` → `this.facade`) | `construct` |
| 4 | `if (OBJECTQL_STRICT_HOOKS) (this as any)._strictHookBinding = true;` | **R1** (`(this.facade as any)…`) | `construct` |
| 5 | `if (OBJECTQL_WARN_LEGACY_HANDLER) (this as any)._warnLegacyHandler = true;` | **R1** | `construct` |
| 6 | `for (…) this.registerMiddleware(storedMetadataTypeReadGate, { object });` | host method (`registerMiddleware`) | `construct` |
| 7 | `this.logger.info('ObjectQL Engine Instance Created');` | host read (`logger` getter) | `construct` |

Measured before the move:
- No written field is `readonly`.
- No field initializer reads a field the constructor writes, and the class has no `super`.
- The constructor runs after every field initializer, as before; statement order is unchanged. `logger` is assigned first, then `construct` runs the rest, so `this.logger` reads the same value it read before.
- Statements 4–5 write through the engine itself (`this.facade`), not a host setter, so the flags land on the engine as before.

### Rules applied

- **Ruling A (6687865760)**: the facade stays the sole state owner. No field moves.
- **R1** (identity port): three sites, statements 3–5.
- **R8** (new, this PR): statement 1.
- **R3, R4, H2, R7**: not reached.
- **Stop condition**: not hit. Statement 1 is the case the order names (a field only a constructor may assign). The seat ruled option A, a codemod capability, instead of a partial move or a terminal row; B (a `!` on the field) was rejected as weakening the compiler's check.

## Tests

- **Codemod self-test**: a new battery, "constructor and definite-assignment wiring (fourth pass, #30020 R8)", 17 cases, floor pinned at 17.
  - Positive: the constructor moves and proves; two runs are byte-identical; exact stub, R8 member and `construct` shapes; imports pruned and moved; setters only for fields the body writes.
  - Refusals: a required field written after another statement; an R8 right side reading `this`; one reading a top-level name of `engine.ts`; a class declaring `construct`.
  - Tampered heads that must fail: an edited R8 right side; a stub missing its R8 line; a marker naming another member; a statement moved above the marker.
- No package test changes: a byte-proven move with no behaviour change.

## Verification

Readings were taken at `b03d09ffb5` (base `af3451b08b`). `3a2c4b4027` merges `origin/main` `9f61e06e6f`, two commits that touch none of these files. At the merge, the undo proof (`--verify --base origin/main`, exit 0, same line) and `--ran` (75/75) were re-run.

<details><summary>Undo proof (byte-exact), determinism, R8 ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base origin/main`: exit 0. "undo proof: 1 moved method(s) (constructor); engine.ts 10739 -> 10712 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte once the 4 import binding(s) only moved bodies read are pruned from the base (STORED_METADATA_TYPE_READ_GATE_OBJECTS, createLogger, startSummaryRefreshOnEnable, storedMetadataTypeReadGate)".
- Determinism: regenerating from the base files with the final codemod writes `engine.ts` (`b612db91…`) and `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts` (`e6599e4b…`) byte-identical to the committed ones (`cmp` clean). Input sha256 `9f090702…` = `git show af3451b08b:packages/objectql/src/engine.ts | sha256sum`.
- **R8 ablation** (temporary local patch, files restored and hash-checked afterwards):
  - R8 off: `definiteAssignmentsOf` returns nothing. The codemod first refuses on its own ("host member logger is read-only there, and a moved body assigns it"). Forcing past that refusal and the undo gate, the generated constructor is the bare `construct.call(…, hostContext)`, and `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/objectql` fails: `src/engine.ts(529,11): error TS2564: Property 'logger' has no initializer and is not definitely assigned in the constructor.` (exit 2).
  - R8 on: the committed tree, `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 186 cases in 12 batteries (169 in 11 before).

</details>

<details><summary>Public declaration files</summary>

`@objectstack/objectql` was built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build`, with the two source files at base `af3451b08b` and then at head. `dist/core.d.ts` (`a8fd9093…`), `dist/index.d.ts` (`3a798237…`) and `dist/util-BK7LVy6k.d.ts` (`24ed9187…`) are byte-equal: `diff -r` is empty. Control: the stub text `HooksAndFunctionsFacet.construct.call(hooksAndFunctionsHost.of(this))` occurs 0 times in the base `dist/index.mjs` and once in the head's.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`, under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0. Test Files 564 passed (564), Tests 11422 passed (11422).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 75 families, all 75 exit 0, recorded as `CMD :: exit N`. `--ran`: 75 derived, 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, at `b03d09ffb5` and again at `3a2c4b4027`. The facade gate is among them (`pnpm check:facade-delegation-only`, 16 named exceptions).
- Outside the derived set:
  - `node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 37 cases.
  - `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
  - `packages/spec` `scripts/liveness/evidence.test.ts`: 48/48, since four names leave `engine.ts`.
  - `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: exit 0, 1145/1155 symbol anchors resolved, 10 on the named #16898 residual.

</details>
